read.thesis: Q2 organic growth 18% with adjusted op margin 22.6% (+410bp) and FY26 guidance raised; but sales timing shifts and inventory/deferred revenue build show demand strength more than supply discipline.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures for full year 2026 are expected to be approximately 4.0% of revenue, at the high end of the range.

triggers.label: Capex ~4.0% of revenue, high end
triggers.quote: Capital expenditures for full year 2026 are expected to be approximately 4.0% of revenue, at the high end of the range.

triggers.label: Adj. op margin 22.6%, up 410bp
triggers.quote: Adjusted operating margin was 22.6%, up 410 basis points compared to second quarter 2025, driven by operational execution

triggers.label: FY26 sales guide raised to $14.0bn
triggers.quote: Expects full year 2026 net sales of $14,000 million and organic sales growth of 31%
